name: FillPDF Media
description: Integrates FillPDF with the Media system.
project_description:
Integrates Drupal core's Media with FillPDF .

 Features 
 Provides a link to Edit FillPDF form from associated PDF Media, removes form elements not relevant with media integration, and more related to integrating Drupal core's Media module with 

 Post-Installation 
 Create a Media type with the machine name pdf .

 Additional Requirements 
 This module knits together the fantastic FillPDF module with Drupal core's Media module.

 No Similar projects known at this time.

 Recommended to potentially use with FillPDF Comprehensive Mapper .
